column5: Review the current application period, apply online or schedule as directed, and gather utility bills, income records, identification, and any disconnection notice.
Call for mental-health or substance-use screening and connection to services. Call or text 988 for crisis support and 911 for immediate danger.

Call or text 988 now, or use the official chat. Call 911 for immediate physical danger or a life-threatening medical emergency.

column1: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
column5: Call the national center and provide the veteran's current location and immediate need. Call 911 for immediate danger.
Use the official locator during tax season, then call the site to confirm dates, eligibility, appointment rules, and required documents.

column1: Capital Area Food Bank — Get Help
column5: Use the official locator and contact the selected pantry or meal site before traveling because schedules, supplies, service areas, and intake rules can change.
Call for shelter information, transportation, or outreach and explain where you will stay tonight. Placement is not guaranteed.
Ask how to complete the current coordinated assessment for the household type and confirm the access point, documents, and next contact.
Check current application availability, identify any eviction or court deadline, and gather the lease, notices, income records, and requested documents. Funding is limited.
Call before visiting to confirm the service, appointment requirements, eligibility, current fees, privacy rules, and records to bring.
Use the official clinic locator and call the selected site before traveling to confirm vaccine availability, age rules, fees, appointments, and records.
Choose a health center and call for an appointment, then ask about insurance, sliding-fee eligibility, services, language access, and documents.
Contact the center about registration, career coaching, job leads, training, unemployment resources, and supportive services.

column1: DC adult education and family literacy
column5: Use the official provider information for literacy, English, high-school-equivalency, or workforce education and confirm enrollment, schedule, and cost.
Review current priority-group and wait-list status, apply through an authorized route, and confirm eligibility, documents, provider rules, and copay.
Plan the trip using current schedules and alerts, then confirm fare, transfers, service changes, and accessibility information before traveling.
Request ADA eligibility before relying on service and confirm certification, reservations, fare, pickup, companion, and visitor rules.

column1: DC Aging and Disability Resource Center
column5: Call and describe the older or disabled person's daily-living, caregiver, food, housing, transportation, and safety needs to identify the correct program.
Check current animal-control, lost-pet, adoption, owner-support, pet-food, and surrender-prevention instructions before visiting; capacity can change.
Contact the office for benefits and claims navigation and ask which discharge, identity, medical, income, and dependent records to bring.
Check the current forecast and active warnings before travel or outdoor plans and follow official protective instructions.
Find a branch and confirm hours, card rules, computer access, printing, learning programs, and registration requirements.

column1: DC Public Library Peer Navigator Program
column5: Check current locations and hours, then meet with a peer navigator for help connecting to identification, benefits, housing, health, employment, or reentry resources.
Review current volunteer opportunities and confirm location, schedule, age, screening, orientation, and registration requirements with the host.

column1: DC Office of the Tenant Advocate
column5: Contact the tenant hotline promptly for rights information and referrals, especially after an eviction notice, rent increase, lockout, unsafe condition, or court filing.
Use the current intake process and identify any court date, eviction, benefits deadline, or other urgent date. Help depends on eligibility and capacity.
